## About
Jorge Morais is a Senior Full Stack Developer from Braga, Portugal, with 5+ years of professional experience specializing in React, Vue.js, Node.js, and TypeScript. He builds production-grade web systems, industrial IoT platforms, and payment machine firmware. EU citizen actively seeking remote opportunities or relocation in Benelux and Nordic regions.

## Notable Projects

### Qore Platform - Enterprise Management Software (Balanças Marques)
- Complete enterprise POS and business management system
- Tech: React, Node.js, TypeScript, Socket.IO, PostgreSQL
- Achievement: Reduced memory consumption from 3GB to 850MB (72% reduction)
- Achievement: Mass data processing pipeline from 2 days to 2 hours (96% faster) for 900k+ POS documents
- Feature: Enterprise AI chat with RBAC, RAG architecture, product knowledge base

### Alice Payment Machine API (Balanças Marques)
- Firmware for automatic payment machines (notes + coins + change)
- Tech: C programming, CCTalk protocol, ID003 protocol
- Hardware: Bill validators, coin mechanisms, sorter hoppers, control boards
- Validated with Valgrind for zero memory leaks

### DataConvert - Data Processing Platform
- SaaS for corporate data processing automation
- Tech: Vue.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL
- Feature: Intelligent PDF table extraction with AI, visual column mapping
- Multi-tenant system

### Q-Scope AI Trading Platform
- Algorithmic trading platform with AI analysis
- Tech: React, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL
- Features: Elliott Wave Theory, NEURO-IA-CORE v4.0, multi-timeframe analysis
- Real-time signal generation and risk management

### Enterprise Websites for Norwegian Clients (Frontkom)
- 10+ websites for Norwegian government and corporate clients
- Tech: React, Next.js, Vue.js, Drupal headless CMS
- WCAG AA accessibility compliance

## Blog & Technical Articles
Jorge writes technical articles about full stack development, performance optimization, embedded systems, and AI.

Blog URL: https://jorgemopanc.com/blog

### Recent Articles
- [The Six Cache Layers Every Developer Should Understand](https://jorgemopanc.com/blog/cache-layers-every-developer-should-know) - Caching is not a single thing, it is a layered discipline. From in-process memory to edge CDN nodes, each layer operates on different trade-offs: speed, scope, persistence, and invalidation cost. This article maps all six layers, explains when to use each, and shows the production patterns that actually work.
- [The AI Multiplier Effect: How LLMs Are Quietly Reshaping Software Teams](https://jorgemopanc.com/blog/ai-multiplier-effect-software-teams) - AI coding tools have been part of my daily workflow for over a year. The productivity shift is real — but the narrative around what that actually means for developers and teams is mostly wrong. This is what I have observed firsthand.
- [TIL: Five Async Node.js Patterns That Changed How I Write Promises](https://jorgemopanc.com/blog/five-async-nodejs-patterns-promises) - Five async patterns in Node.js that I keep reaching for in production code: Promise.allSettled for fault-tolerant fan-outs, AbortController for cancellable fetches, async iterators for backpressure-aware streaming, concurrency limiters for not hammering third-party APIs, and structured error boundaries that actually make try/catch useful again.
